title: A Strategy Under Strain
subtitle: Operational exhaustion and competing strategic objectives
author: R.G. Cruise
phase: II — The Drive into the Soviet Interior
summary: Planned study: Directive No. 34, German supply and repair problems, Soviet reserves and continuing fighting across all three sectors.
outlineTopics: The condition of Army Group Center after weeks of heavy fighting.
Increasing German supply and transportation problems.
Armored vehicle attrition and maintenance difficulties.
The growing distance between armored spearheads and their supporting formations.
Soviet mobilization and the continued arrival of new forces.
The postponement of further major objectives for Army Group Center and the need to rehabilitate its panzer formations.
The differing operational priorities of the German high command.
Army Group North's difficulties on the Leningrad approaches.
The developing encirclement battle around Uman.
Why Germany's rapid advances had not resulted in the anticipated destruction of Soviet resistance.
